title: Social Market
tagline: The platform is used to sell a social media account directly from person to person in a decentralized way, without an intermediary.
description:
The platform is used to sell a social media account directly from person to person in a decentralized way, without an intermediary. The platform is used to sell a social media account directly from person to person in a decentralized way, without an intermediary.

We used World ID's verifiable human technology. Because all accounts are individual, may contain personal information or must be owned by people we are sure are human. So we can eliminate bots.

By generating NFT with the Filecoin AI tool, we enable the accounts to be sold as NFT.


The project is built on the ethereum network.
